about_the_game:
Can one gorilla really beat 100 men?
What happens next is pure, physics-driven carnage.

Gorilla Smash is a chaotic, over-the-top brawler where you take on a frenzy of puny humans with nothing but brute strength, devastating blows, and pure gorilla rage. Smash your way through a mob of enemies in chaotic, arena-style battles where sheer strength meets overwhelming numbers. Dodge attacks, land devastating hits, and survive the absurdity. Some enemies come at you unarmed. Others come with weapons. Either way — they’re all going down.

💥 FEATURES:

  • 🦍 Play as a massive, unstoppable gorilla

  • 👊 100 Men Stand in Your Way – Fight through mobs of unarmed and armed enemies

  • 🧠 Physics-based mayhem with ragdoll enemy reactions

  • 🪓 Meme-fueled violence that’s as hilarious as it is brutal

  • 🚀 Quick & Addictive Gameplay – Jump in, go wild, replay anytime

  • 💀 No mercy. No weapons. No problem.

This is not a game of stealth. It’s not about tactics.
It’s about pure primal SMASHING.
Can you take down 100 men... or will the horde finally take you down?

Smash first. Ask questions never.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains frequent and intense depictions of cartoonish violence, including exaggerated hand-to-hand combat between a powerful gorilla and waves of unarmed human characters. Players will witness characters being thrown, punched, and incapacitated in over-the-top and often humorous ways. While there is no graphic gore, there are blood effects. The physical confrontations are central to gameplay and may not be suitable for younger audiences.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 or AMD Radeon R9 380 (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Minimum specs are aimed at 1080p resolution, low-to-medium settings, 30+ FPS.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 Super or AMD Radeon RX 6800
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Currently not supported
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for 1440p gaming, high settings, 60+ FPS.

short_description: One gorilla, One Hundred men! A physics-based brawler where you play as a furious gorilla battling waves of armed and unarmed men. Dodge, smash, and survive chaotic arena fights fueled by meme energy and raw power.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America
*languages with full audio support
